hooks.command: main="$(git -C "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}" worktree list --porcelain | sed -n '1s/^worktree //p')"; if [ "$(git -C "$main" branch --show-current)" = main ]; then git -C "$main" pull --ff-only --prune --quiet || echo '{"systemMessage":"Could not fast-forward main in the main checkout. Pull it by hand."}'; fi
hooks.statusMessage: Pulling the latest main into the main checkout
